title: Mindwalk: replays your Claude Code and Codex sessions as a 3D repo map
description:
Mindwalk replays Claude Code and Codex sessions as a 3D map of your repository instead of making you parse JSONL to understand what an agent did. After a risky change, you want to know where it explored, which files it ignored, and when editing began. Mindwalk lights each file by touch depth, flags churn and errors in a review strip, and lets you scrub context compactions, subagent launches, and user turns.

https://github.com/cosmtrek/mindwalk
